TutorHub V2 — self-hosted MediaPipe assets for classroom visual effects (ADR-0041)
================================================================================

These files are served same-origin from /vendor/mediapipe/ so the background
effects pipeline never loads code or models from a third-party CDN at runtime.
They are byte-for-byte copies; see SHA256SUMS.txt for the pinned digests.

wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js
wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm
wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.js
wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.wasm
  Source:  npm package @mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14 (directory "wasm/")
  Project: MediaPipe — https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
  License: Apache License, Version 2.0
  Copyright holders: The MediaPipe Authors (package author: mediapipe@google.com)

models/selfie_segmenter.tflite
  Source:  MediaPipe "selfie_segmenter" image segmenter model (float16, v1),
           249,537 bytes, downloaded and verified by the TutorHub Gatekeeper
  Project: MediaPipe — https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
  License: Apache License, Version 2.0
  Copyright holders: The MediaPipe Authors (package author: mediapipe@google.com)
